findings.title: Image pull secret does not exist
findings.cause: the pod pulls image ghcr.io/sunilmehta-si/kube-diagnose-missing:1.0.0 with imagePullSecret ghcr-creds, which does not exist in namespace kd-pull-secret-missing, so the registry sees no credentials; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: Back-off pulling image "ghcr.io/sunilmehta-si/kube-diagnose-missing:1.0.0": ErrImagePull: failed to pull and unpack image "ghcr.io/sunilmehta-si/kube-diagnose-missing:1.0.0": failed to resolve reference "ghcr.io/sunilmehta-si/kube-diagnose-missing:1.0.0": failed to authorize: failed to fetch anonymous token: unexpected status from GET request to https://ghcr.io/token?scope=repository%3Asunilmehta-si%2Fkube-diagnose-missing%3Apull&service=ghcr.io: 403 Forbidden

Failed to pull image "ghcr.io/sunilmehta-si/kube-diagnose-missing:1.0.0": failed to pull and unpack image "ghcr.io/sunilmehta-si/kube-diagnose-missing:1.0.0": failed to resolve reference "ghcr.io/sunilmehta-si/kube-diagnose-missing:1.0.0": failed to authorize: failed to fetch anonymous token: unexpected status from GET request to https://ghcr.io/token?scope=repository%3Asunilmehta-si%2Fkube-diagnose-missing%3Apull&service=ghcr.io: 403 Forbidden
Unable to retrieve some image pull secrets (ghcr-creds); attempting to pull the image may not succeed.

evidence.what: there is no Secret ghcr-creds in namespace kd-pull-secret-missing

findings.fix: Create the docker-registry Secret ghcr-creds in namespace kd-pull-secret-missing (kubectl create secret docker-registry), or correct imagePullSecrets.
